Container.Name: ironsbot
Container.Overview: EN: IronsBot custom image for Seer information queries, NoneBot2/OneBot v11 messaging, and Unraid-friendly operation. Behavior config lives in /config/ironsbot.toml, data and logs use persistent appdata mounts, and environment variables are reserved for secrets, credentials, and runtime deployment settings. ZH: IronsBot 是面向赛尔号查询、NoneBot2/OneBot v11 消息和 Unraid 部署的自定义镜像。行为配置写入 /config/ironsbot.toml，数据和日志使用 appdata 持久化挂载，环境变量只保留密钥、凭据和部署运行参数。
Container.Description: EN: IronsBot is a NoneBot2 / OneBot v11 QQ bot image for Seer queries, group replies, Bilibili dynamic monitoring, activity reminders, AI chat, and Unraid deployment. The behavior config is /config/ironsbot.toml. If it is missing on first startup, the container creates it from config.example.toml without overwriting existing files. Runtime data is stored in /app/data. File logs can be stored in /app/logs. Superusers can run /更新数据 to refresh SQLite data. When the Docker socket is mounted, /重启机器人, /更新镜像, and startup image checks can restart or update the current container through Docker/Watchtower. ZH: IronsBot 是基于 NoneBot2 和 OneBot v11 的 QQ 机器人镜像，面向赛尔号查询、群聊回复、B 站动态监控、活动提醒、AI 聊天和 Unraid 部署。行为配置文件是 /config/ironsbot.toml；首次启动缺失时会从 config.example.toml 自动创建，不覆盖已有文件。运行数据保存到 /app/data，文件日志可保存到 /app/logs。超级管理员可用 /更新数据 刷新 SQLite 数据；挂载 Docker socket 后，/重启机器人、/更新镜像 和启动镜像检查可通过 Docker/Watchtower 重启或更新当前容器。
Container.Requires: EN: Requires a OneBot v11 client such as NapCat. Configure the client reverse WebSocket to ws://UNRAID_SERVER_IP:8085/onebot/v11/ws, or use ws://ironsbot:8080/onebot/v11/ws when both containers share a Docker network. Keep /config writable for the first startup so /config/ironsbot.toml can be created automatically. Mount /app/data and /app/logs for persistent runtime files. Mount /var/run/docker.sock only if you want Docker image checks and container self-update. See the README link for full configuration notes. ZH: 需要 NapCat 等 OneBot v11 客户端。反向 WebSocket 可填 ws://UNRAID_SERVER_IP:8085/onebot/v11/ws；如果 NapCat 和 IronsBot 在同一 Docker 网络，也可填 ws://ironsbot:8080/onebot/v11/ws。首次启动请保持 /config 可写，以便自动创建 /config/ironsbot.toml。建议挂载 /app/data 和 /app/logs 持久化运行数据和日志；只有需要镜像检查或容器自更新时才挂载 /var/run/docker.sock。完整说明见 README 链接。
Container.Changes:
Version scheme: - latest: current main branch of this fork. - project-version.revision: current IronsBot project version plus repository revision count. - sha-xxxxxxx: exact Git commit used to build the image.
Current deployment notes / 当前部署说明: - EN: Behavior config is file-based at /config/ironsbot.toml. ZH: 行为配置文件是 /config/ironsbot.toml。 - EN: Missing /config/ironsbot.toml is auto-created from config.example.toml on first startup. ZH: 首次启动缺失该文件时，会从 config.example.toml 自动创建。 - EN: Missing ironsbot.env.example is also generated next to the TOML as an environment sample. ZH: 缺失 ironsbot.env.example 时，也会在同目录生成环境变量示例。 - EN: Runtime data belongs in /app/data and file logs belong in /app/logs. ZH: 运行数据放在 /app/data，文件日志放在 /app/logs。 - EN: Bilibili uses the accounts/accounts-per-target TOML model, not raw UID lists. ZH: B 站配置使用账号别名库和目标账号列表，不再使用原始 UID 列表。 - EN: Team resource reminders use the team_resource_subscription feature. ZH: 战队资源提醒使用 team_resource_subscription 功能。 - EN: Startup, Docker image checks, data sync, Bilibili, AI error, and other push notices can be managed with TD. ZH: 启动、镜像检查、数据同步、B 站、AI 异常等推送可通过 TD 单独管理。 - EN: /重启机器人, /更新镜像, and /更新Docker enter the same restart/update flow. ZH: /重启机器人、/更新镜像、/更新Docker 进入同一套重启/更新流程。

Config.Name: WebSocket Port
Config.Description: EN: Host port mapped to container port 8080. Point NapCat / OneBot reverse WebSocket at this port. ZH: 主机端口映射到容器内 8080，NapCat / OneBot 反向 WebSocket 连接这个端口。

Config.Name: IronsBot Data
Config.Description: EN: Persistent runtime data: plugin caches, Bilibili cookies, SQLite databases, and local cache files. ZH: 持久化运行数据目录，用来保存插件缓存、B 站 Cookie、SQLite 数据库和本地缓存文件。

Config.Name: IronsBot Logs
Config.Description: EN: Persistent file logs. When runtime.logging.file_enabled is true, full logs go to /app/logs/ironsbot.log and ERROR/CRITICAL logs go to /app/logs/ironsbot.error.log. ZH: 持久化日志目录。启用 runtime.logging.file_enabled 后，完整日志写入 /app/logs/ironsbot.log，错误日志写入 /app/logs/ironsbot.error.log。

Config.Name: IronsBot Config
Config.Description: EN: Behavior config directory. If /config/ironsbot.toml is missing on first startup, IronsBot creates it from config.example.toml without overwriting existing files. ZH: 行为配置目录。首次启动缺少 /config/ironsbot.toml 时，会从 config.example.toml 自动创建，已有文件不会被覆盖。

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: EN: Optional. Enables /重启机器人, /更新镜像, and startup image checks through Docker API / Watchtower. This grants the container control over the host Docker engine. ZH: 可选。挂载后 /重启机器人、/更新镜像 和启动镜像检查可通过 Docker API / Watchtower 重启或更新当前容器。该 socket 等同授予容器宿主机 Docker 控制权限。

Config.Name: Environment
Config.Description: EN: NoneBot environment name. Use prod for normal deployment. ZH: NoneBot 运行环境名，生产环境通常填 prod。

Config.Name: Driver
Config.Description: EN: NoneBot driver configuration. Keep ~fastapi+~httpx for OneBot reverse WebSocket and HTTP requests. ZH: NoneBot 驱动配置，保持 ~fastapi+~httpx 即可支持 OneBot 反向 WebSocket 和 HTTP 请求。

Config.Name: Host
Config.Description: EN: Container listen address. Use 0.0.0.0 for Docker / Unraid. ZH: 容器内监听地址，Docker / Unraid 中建议 0.0.0.0。

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: EN: Container listen port. Keep it aligned with the mapped container port. ZH: 容器内监听端口，需与端口映射的容器端口一致。

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: EN: Console log level: TRACE, DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, or ERROR. ZH: 控制台日志级别，可填 TRACE、DEBUG、INFO、WARNING 或 ERROR。

Config.Name: Command Start
Config.Description: EN: NoneBot command prefixes. Including an empty string allows direct keyword commands. ZH: NoneBot 命令前缀列表，包含空字符串时可直接发送口令。

Config.Name: App Config Path
Config.Description: EN: Behavior TOML path. Keep /config/ironsbot.toml for Unraid. Missing TOML creates config.example.toml-based config and ironsbot.env.example on first startup. ZH: 行为配置 TOML 路径。Unraid 中保持 /config/ironsbot.toml；缺失时首次启动会自动创建示例配置和 ironsbot.env.example。

Config.Name: OneBot Access Token
Config.Description: EN: OneBot connection token. Must match the access_token configured in NapCat or another OneBot client. ZH: OneBot 连接令牌，必须和 NapCat 等 OneBot 客户端的 access_token 一致。

Config.Name: Superusers
Config.Description: EN: Required NoneBot superuser QQ list. Example: [1234567890] or ["1234567890"]. ZH: 必填，NoneBot 超级管理员 QQ 列表。示例：[1234567890] 或 ["1234567890"]。

Config.Name: Headless Seer User ID
Config.Description: EN: Optional Seer account ID for headless login / game automation. Leave empty if unused. ZH: 可选，米米号账号。只有需要无头登录或赛尔号自动化操作时填写，不使用时留空。

Config.Name: Headless Seer Password
Config.Description: EN: Optional Seer password MD5 for headless login. Leave empty if unused. ZH: 可选，米米号密码的 MD5 值。不使用无头登录时留空。

Config.Name: AI Chat API Key
Config.Description: EN: Optional AI API key, such as DeepSeek or another OpenAI-compatible provider. Keep it secret. ZH: 可选，AI API Key，例如 DeepSeek 或其他 OpenAI 兼容服务密钥，请保密。

Config.Name: SendPic CNB Token
Config.Description: EN: Optional CNB backend token for custom_sendpic. Repository and behavior settings live in /config/ironsbot.toml. ZH: 可选，custom_sendpic 使用 CNB 后端时的访问令牌；仓库名等行为配置写在 /config/ironsbot.toml。

Config.Name: GitHub Workflow Token
Config.Description: EN: Optional token for remote_build data refresh. Recommended fine-grained permissions: Actions read/write and Metadata read for target repositories. ZH: 可选，启用数据源 remote_build 时用于触发 GitHub Actions。建议 fine-grained token 只给目标仓库 Actions 读写和 Metadata 读取权限。
